about: The Tide-Pen: a coastal care pen on the Ocean's tide-pool shelf, reached by sky-sea boat from World-Zero's rim dock (data/ocean/links.json). Rule: a creature may be penned (enclosed or captured) only after a verified settled_care fact exists for that actor and that creature. Leaving a creature wild is always allowed. Fantasy rule, not biology. Nothing here runs yet: capture/enclose and a host fact store do not exist (audit 2026-10-15).

settled_care.meaning: fed the creature its own food on at least two different days, never harmed it, and planted at least one of its habitat plants in the pen
settled_care.issuer: trusted host only (pattern: daedalus-core simulation/LivingWorld receipts: idempotent request id, server-written)

actions.enclose: REFUSE unless settled_care holds for this actor and creature
actions.capture: REFUSE unless settled_care holds for this actor and creature
actions.feed: ALLOW; the host records a care event
actions.harm: the host records a harm event; settled_care can no longer be earned for that creature

decision_code: daedalus-core com.daedalus.world.ocean.TidePenGate (pure; no store, no authority)

steps: feed a resident its food on two days
choose: pen it (now allowed) or leave it wild
